messages.author: 5c3432e7ad5f7291
messages.subject: setting ylim in scale_x_discrete
parts:
Hello,

 

The code below works fine but ggplot complains about  “Scale for 'x' is already present. Adding another scale for x …”.

Is there a way to include the last statement xlim("H","F","J","D") into the scale_x_discrete() statement and “avoid adding another scale for x”.

Thanks.

 

p <- ggplot() +

  coord_cartesian() +

  scale_x_discrete() +

  scale_y_continuous() +

  layer(

    data=diamonds,

    mapping=aes(x=color),

   stat="bin", stat_params=list(),

    geom="bar", geom_params=list(),

    position=position_identity()

  )

 

p <- p + xlim("H","F","J","D")
